name: Ozzienet
summary: Wholesale + retail internet access provider ('become your own ISP', ~2001, trading as OzzieNet, Bunbury); acquired by Datafast Telecommunications in Jun 2004 (renamed Eftel 2005).

events.details: Acquired by Datafast Telecommunications in Jun 2004 (Bunbury 'OzzieNet' ISP); Datafast renamed Eftel Dec 2005.
